machine: Fedora 45, GNOME 51.1 Wayland, AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D, NVIDIA RTX 4070 Ti SUPER (620.70.06 open kernel modules); every process pinned to CPU 2 with taskset (startup: CPUs 2-7)
method: interleaved rounds, the order reversed every other round; each value is one suite run median; the new pin also runs a second time in each round as 'same binary again'
